content: Arjun: Let's keep this quick. Neha, where are we on the Q3 campaign deck? Neha: Draft is 80% done. I'll send it to Arjun for review by Wednesday. Arjun: Good. Also, remind me — I told Raghav I'd send him the updated vendor list. I'll get that to him by end of day tomorrow. Raghav: Appreciated. Separately, the Mumbai office renewal paperwork needs someone to sign off this week. Not sure whose desk that's on right now. Divya: I think that's supposed to be Facilities, but I haven't seen anyone pick it up. Arjun: Okay, flag it, don't assume. Divya, can you also pull the July expense variance report before Thursday's board prep? Divya: Yes, I'll have it ready Wednesday evening. Arjun: One more thing — client call with Meridian Logistics got pushed. I need to reconfirm the new time with their team myself. Neha: Also, just a reminder, the campaign deck review — I said Wednesday, but realistically Thursday morning is safer. Arjun: Noted. Let's close here.
From: raghav.sethi... To: arjun.malhotra... "Following up from the sync — can you send the updated vendor list today?"
From: arjun.malhotra... To: raghav.sethi... "Running behind, will send first thing tomorrow morning instead."
From: raghav.sethi... To: arjun.malhotra... "No worries, whenever you get a chance today works."
From: arjun.malhotra... To: raghav.sethi... "Sorry, got pulled into board prep — will send by tomorrow (Wednesday) morning for sure."
From: raghav.sethi... To: arjun.malhotra... "Just checking — still good for this morning?"
From: neha.kapoor... To: arjun.malhotra... "Deck's coming together, still targeting Wednesday for your review."
From: neha.kapoor... To: arjun.malhotra... "Heads up — shifting the review to Thursday morning instead of Wednesday, need one more day on the data slides."
From: arjun.malhotra... To: neha.kapoor... "Understood, Thursday morning works. What time exactly?"
From: neha.kapoor... To: arjun.malhotra... "Let's say 9:30 AM Thursday, before your board prep block."
From: neha.kapoor... To: arjun.malhotra... "Deck is ready, attaching the draft ahead of our 9:30 review."
From: priya.nair... To: arjun.malhotra... "Our scheduled call this week got bumped from our side — can you propose a new time? We're flexible Tuesday–Thursday afternoons."
From: arjun.malhotra... To: priya.nair... "Apologies for the delay — how about Wednesday 3:00 PM?"
From: priya.nair... To: arjun.malhotra... "Wednesday 3 PM works on our end, confirmed."
From: priya.nair... To: arjun.malhotra... "Quick check — still on for 3 PM today?"
From: arjun.malhotra... To: priya.nair... "Yes, confirmed, see you at 3."
From: divya.rao... To: arjun.malhotra... "Starting on the July variance numbers, targeting Thursday morning for board prep as discussed."
From: arjun.malhotra... To: divya.rao... "Actually, can I get it by Wednesday evening instead? Want time to review before Thursday."
From: divya.rao... To: arjun.malhotra... "Wednesday evening is tight but doable, I'll prioritize it."
From: divya.rao... To: arjun.malhotra... "Report attached, sent as promised."
From: arjun.malhotra... To: divya.rao... "Got it, thank you — exactly what I needed before tomorrow."
From: facilities... To: All Staff "Reminder: the Mumbai office lease renewal requires an authorized signature by Friday, 25 September."
From: raghav.sethi... To: arjun.malhotra..., divya.rao... "Following up from the sync — has anyone confirmed who's signing off on the Mumbai renewal? Don't think it's been assigned."
From: divya.rao... To: raghav.sethi..., arjun.malhotra... "Not on my end — I believe this typically sits with Facilities directly, not us."
From: facilities... To: All Staff "Second reminder: signature is still pending. Deadline is Friday, 25 September, end of day."
From: raghav.sethi... To: arjun.malhotra... "This is now one day out and still unowned — can you confirm who's handling it?"

Quick note to self — need to get Raghav that vendor list, I think I said today but it might slip to tomorrow morning, remind me. Also still haven't heard back on the Mumbai lease thing, someone needs to own that, I don't think it's me.

Reminder — expense variance report from Divya needs to be in my hands by Wednesday evening, not Thursday, I want time to go through it before board prep. Also Meridian call — I owe Priya a time, need to lock that in today.
Event: Board Prep Session. Time: Thu 24 Sep, 9:00–10:00 AM. Owner: Arjun Malhotra
